page.overview:
Who is Hasuta?

Hasuta (also known as Hastur) is an extraterrestrial entity from the fictional universe of the Haiyore! Nyaruko-san series.

Hasuta was a childhood friend of Nyaruko and Kuuko. His father is the owner of the Carcosa Computer Entertainment corporation and Hasuta was initially sent to Earth to help their gaming company win the extraterrestrial console wars. Although, after he failed the mission, Hasuta joined the Space Defense Agency and remained on Earth to help protect a human boy named Mahiro Yasaka. Hasuta quickly fell in love with him and, despite Mahiro not being interested in him romantically, the two of them are generally in good terms. Kuuko initially wanted them to be together so she can have Nyaruko all to herself, until she set her sights on having a threesome with both Mahiro and Nyaruko.

Hasuta takes the form of a young feminine boy with blond hair, however, he is capable of transforming into his "King in Yellow" super mode where he appears to be more masculine and mature. His species was the inspiration for the character "Hastur" from the Cthulhu Mythos. He is physically stronger than Nyaruko and Kuuko, and in combat, he uses the power of wind manipulation.
